notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
This update has a lot of changes:

[list]
[*] All 20 cars are now unlocked
[*] Car handling has been overhauled
[*] Car brakes are now stronger and can be locked up
[*] Cars are now limited in speed by the gear they're in
[*] Cars now have damage and will crash/respawn
[*] Car slipstreaming now works as intended (speedometer turns green whilst slipstreaming)
[*] Opponent cars are now more competitive
[*] Leaderboards have been reset
[*] Updated menu graphics
[*] Updated CRT effect
[*] Fixed issue where cars would be sent flying when hitting the curbs
[*] Fixed various small bugs and issues
[*] 
[*] Demo version is no longer available.
[/list]

Please leave any feedback in the usual places!
